# Business idea (draft v1)

Problem: Small restaurants like my parents' 40-seat place in San Jose run on thin margins, and owners spend hours on scheduling, inventory, and reconciling supplier invoices by hand. Existing POS systems are built for chains.

Idea: a lightweight back-office tool for independent restaurants: auto-matches supplier invoices to purchases, flags food-cost spikes, and builds weekly staff schedules from forecast covers.
